reward.scale_interpretation: Exponential force scale, not a minimum-load constraint, required50:50 split or acceptance threshold.
reward.force_source: Unthresholded normal-only ContactSensor.data.force_matrix_w from two distinct wheel/actual-ground filters; world Z with physical5ms impulse conversion.
reward.normalization: Actual startup live CPU link masses and native downward gravity; float64 mass reduction followed by cached float32CUDA mg per environment. No mass/gravity randomization or cache replacement.
reward.integration: Original50Hz RewardManager20ms factor; no all-substep mean or observer/history/reset hook.
reward.risks: Soft balanced-load preference at fixed total force, but also preference for larger total forces; may alter posture, suppress sideslip or favor impacts. All original motion/impact/height/stop gates remain authoritative. No PhysX/MuJoCo force-equivalence or hardware claim.

training.checkpoint_selection: Only predesignated model_final.pt after all600 updates; no intermediate-best checkpoint, extra update, gain/scale search or retrospective factor change.
training.failure_policy: Preserve actual startup/runtime/incomplete records. Incomplete training is not a final trained-policy evaluation; do not automatically restart or change source/budget/device.

learning_rate_resume.adaptive_schedule: Unchanged after the single initial scalar synchronization; no fixed-rate override, clamp or rescheduling.
learning_rate_resume.recording: Persist matching dedicated and manifest LR audit before training_started and learning; audit actual installed sources before load.

unchanged.optimizer_restoration: Original runner.load(load_optimizer=True), restoring Adam moments/counts; no reinitialization.
unchanged.normalization: Restore actor/critic buffers and counts, then continue original train-mode updates; no freeze/reset.
unchanged.environment: Same fresh environment and eight zero-action smoke steps/reset. The original loader does not restore environment/sampler/RNG continuation state; sensor/cache initialization is deterministic and adds no RNG/reset/history hook.
unchanged.objective: All original004 rewards and last-substep sampling remain; only the declared reserve term is added relative to012.
unchanged.motor_randomization: Existing motor-v1 wheel shaft friction, motor no-load speed and torque-capacity distributions; episode-fixed with20% nominal resets. No contact/mass/gravity randomization.
unchanged.contract_exception: Only task_profile reflects the added reserve reward; actor/critic/action/controller/clock/initialization fields remain unchanged.

evaluation.conditions: Nominal motors, original frame0 and initial velocities; no additional lateral reset velocity, hidden root writes or controller/physics override.
evaluation.recording: Actual200Hz first-episode states/contacts in both engines and unchanged50Hz actor observations/actions.
evaluation.acceptance: Every original gate unchanged: >=0.20s uninterrupted speed>=0.4m/s, positive forward component, abs(beta)>=8deg, both actual bearing contacts and contact-patch lateral slip>=0.04m/s; plus original tracking, height, progress, support, nonwheel-impact, duration and stable stopping. No gap bridging.
evaluation.provenance: Actual final013 checkpoint; all exported actor/normalizer tensors equal that checkpoint, same actor bytes between engines, all applied pre-action rows independently replayed. No learned-actor equality to004/010/012 is required.
evaluation.comparison: Recorded-only013 versus012 primary control and004/010 descriptive baselines; fixed original source windows [.78,1.44] and[1.82,2.32]. No fitted alignment, force recomputation, production reward reconstruction or extra acceptance gate.
evaluation.publication: Mandatory explicit013 LR-and-reserve-aware publisher with protocol/source10/startup/CPUcompletion/paired-actor proof. Frozen legacy and012 publishers are not the013 publication route.
evaluation.format: Captured car -> exported TRON1 kinematics -> Isaac policy -> MuJoCo same actor; full four-panel video/contact curves and every failed gate. Preserve initial jump and all historical snapshots.
evaluation.limitations: One seed and one nominal first episode per engine. Lower reserve cost or better engine agreement is not motion success; no causal, statistical-robustness, contact-law-equivalence or hardware-readiness claim.

resources.mode: One owned app on freshly idle target, unmasked native/tensorCUDA5 audit; no automatic fallback.
resources.budget: 4500s training and900s evaluation timeout; TERM thenKILL after30s affects only the newly owned process group.
resources.evidence: Exclusive fsynced receipts/logs beforePopen; actual launcher/wrapper/app PIDs, allGPU context snapshots, independent process/GPU exit checks.
resources.cross_gpu_contexts: Isaac may create contexts on all eight GPUs; physical mapping/isolation and harmlessness on other cards are not claimed. Idle checks are not atomic reservations.
